title: Cod with pesto and butter beans
summary: Cod with pesto and butter beans is a italian dinner built around cod fillets and canned butter beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat cod fillets dry and season it. Prep canned butter beans and fresh basil pesto for Cod with pesto and butter beans so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook cod fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook canned butter beans and fresh basil pesto in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Cod with pesto and butter beans before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice cod fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
